evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Work within a governed metadata framework where documentation is a delivery requirement
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Governance, documentation, quality frameworks, and dimensional modeling rigor dominate the responsibilities, with only one secondary mention of 'speed-to-delivery'.
evidence.domain_risk: Harmonize data across manufacturing sites, software, and platforms for enterprise-level consumption
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Pharmaceutical manufacturing and enterprise-level data at a regulated life-sciences company implies high domain risk even without explicit regulatory language in responsibilities.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Incorporating domain-specific data marts into a centralized, foundational core
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The role builds a centralized data layer from domain-specific marts already in use across manufacturing sites, indicating an established but consolidating function — mid maturity.
evidence.jd_authorship: designing and maintaining dimensional data models (star/snowflake schemas), including fact and dimension table design, slowly changing dimensions (SCD), and conformed dimensions
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Precise technical terminology (SCD, conformed dimensions, DAG-based pipelines) shows hiring-manager authorship with a clear picture of daily work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Develop a centralized data-layer to deliver data-products at scale to the business
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role is oriented around building the internal data platform/layer itself rather than any single external-facing commercial, product, or finance function.
evidence.autonomy_level: Designing highly organized and scalable architectural solutions to drive efficiency...Collaborate with the business to gather requirements
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Combines strategic architectural ownership (orchestration strategy, centralized data layer) with execution-driven requirement gathering and delivery, placing it in mixed autonomy.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI tool usage or AI-adjacent data infrastructure work is mentioned anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: Work within Data Build Tool (dbt) to deliver documented, tested, and DRY ("don't-repeat-yourself") code
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing is explicitly framed as an owned delivery practice via dbt, alongside a governed metadata framework and quality frameworks the candidate follows.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: focusing on data architecture, quality, and governance...Follow analytical lifecycle process and quality frameworks to deliver accurate data
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: High framing — governance, documentation-as-delivery-requirement, and quality frameworks dominate throughout, reflecting a strong trust/accuracy risk register typical of a regulated pharmaceutical company.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Develop a centralized data-layer to deliver data-products at scale to the business...Incorporating domain-specific data marts into a centralized, foundational core
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Mix of building new centralized infrastructure (greenfield) and consolidating/harmonizing existing domain-specific data marts (fix_scale).
evidence.loss_aversion: Work within a governed metadata framework where documentation is a delivery requirement — strong governance/quality framing consistent with a regulated pharmaceutical company, though not explicitly regulatory-worded.
